# Ohio Tiger - DGMS Law

> > Ohio Tiger is the online home of DGMS Law, a top-tier personal injury law firm with $3B+ in settlements across Ohio, Kentucky, and Indiana.

DGMS Law (Dyer, Garofalo, Mann & Schultz) has served over 100,000 clients since 1991, specializing in car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle accidents, medical malpractice, slip and fall injuries, dog bites, and wrongful death claims. The firm maintains multiple offices across Ohio and neighboring states.
